padding:I2778:128849;1037:48645;245:2027.note: The balance number in the 「credit」 pill sits about 6 pt nearer the coin icon and about 2 pt nearer the right edge than the Design draws (Design: 32 pt from the pill's left edge to the number, 12 pt on the right; app: 26 pt and about 10 pt). The gap between the coin and the number shrinks to about 5 pt, so a five-digit balance looks cramped; the larger sample balance does not explain it, since the pill hugs its number and the insets should stay the same. Same pill on every chat screen of the feature: one fix covers them all.
padding:I2778:128849;1037:48645;245:2027.note_zh: 「credit」膠囊裡的餘額數字比 Design 更靠近金幣圖示約 6 pt、靠右邊緣約 2 pt（Design：膠囊左緣到數字 32 pt、右側 12 pt；App：26 pt 與約 10 pt）。金幣與數字的間距縮到約 5 pt，五位數餘額看起來很擠；這不是樣本數字較長造成的，膠囊包住數字，內距應維持不變。功能內每個對話畫面的同一顆膠囊都一樣，修一處即全部修正。
